name: Howling Insect
source_text: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster with an ATK of 1500 or less to your side of the field from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
notes: Recruits a Insect monster with ATK <= 1500 in face-up Attack Position.
